home.title: Shift report
home.recordLede: The morning after every shift: who worked, the hours, and every incident logged with the time.
log: On site. Briefing with the duty manager. Radios checked.
Refused entry: one guest, intoxicated. Left without incident.
First aid: small cut to a guest’s hand, cleaned and dressed. Venue accident book updated.
Venue clear. Doors locked with the manager.

event-security.title: Event report
event-security.recordLede: The team, the timings and anything that happened, the morning after, for you and anyone you answer to.
log: Team briefed. Gates, bars and stage front staffed to the plan.
Gates open. Ticket and bag checks running at both entrances.
Crowd building at the stage front: two officers moved from the bar.
Last guests out. Car park clear.

retail-security.title: Shift report
retail-security.recordLede: Every incident written up, so you have a record for the police and your insurer.
log: On the floor at the entrance. Briefed by the store manager.
Customer helped to find a lost bag. Handed in at customer services.
Suspected theft of razor blades. Person approached, items returned, left the store.
Store closed with the duty manager.

office-security.title: Shift report
office-security.recordLede: Visitors, patrols and anything out of the ordinary, logged with the time.
log: Reception open. Doors and fire exits checked.
Six visitors signed in. One without a booking: host called before entry.
Patrol: every floor, plant room and car park. All secure.
Building clear. Doors locked and alarm set.

mobile-patrols.title: Patrol log
mobile-patrols.recordLede: Times, findings and photos for each visit, so you can see the work was done.
log: Visit 1. Doors, shutters and fences checked. Photos taken.
Visit 2. Gate chain found loose: secured and photographed.
Alarm activation. Officer attended: no sign of entry. Site secured, alarm reset.
Visit 3. All secure.

cctv-monitoring.title: Monitoring log
cctv-monitoring.recordLede: A written report of every incident, with the footage times, for you and your insurer.
log: Monitoring starts. All cameras checked.
Two people at the rear fence. Patrol sent.
Patrol on site. People gone, fence intact. Footage kept from 23:41 to 23:58.
No further activity. Monitoring ends.
